name: mafia
description: Online multiplayer Mafia / Werewolf party game with an automatic narrator

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
